rationale: CR-001 and CR-002 are resolved in commit 057835cd8. _process now splits first and runs guardrails on the final chunks, so the header text is guarded exactly as embedded (new test test_guardrails_applied_to_final_chunks_including_header, RED then GREEN). The storage fixtures are 1-based and the split test asserts the last tool name. 144 targeted tests pass, the image was rebuilt and the live check passes 13/13. No new high-risk issue: guardrails now run once per chunk instead of once per assistant, which only adds calls for multi-chunk assistants when guardrails are configured.
